subject: 辽金北方城门守舍（原创扩展）
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: tianshu building-map sprite bld_kit_liao_jin_north_guardhouse. Create ONE NEW small Liao-Jin northern city-gate guardhouse, anonymous original game building. Reference image is ONLY for style/material/camera consistency with approved Song kit, not a copy target. Rectangular single-storey 7 x 5 metre footprint. Earth-plastered ochre-beige walls with dark structural timbers, plain solid wooden plank doors and narrow straight-bar window, heavy slightly low grey clay-tile gabled roof with minimal ridge ornament, a small open front shelter held by two heavy posts and a plain low timber rail. Practical northern garrison building, no exotic tents, no palace details, no towers, no defensive walls. Main door facing SCREEN LOWER LEFT. Realistic ancient construction and fine weathered textures, soft old wood and grey stone foundation, sober and solid. Exact orthographic yaw45 pitch30, 2:1 ground projection, ground edges at +/-0.500 slopes, no perspective. Ground footprint 7 east-west by 5 north-south, down-right edge 1.4x up-right edge in screen horizontal extent. Thin flat footprint skirt with left, front, right ground corners unobstructed, not a floating block. Isolated full silhouette at least 10% transparent margin, true RGBA clear background, no sky, no background scene, no checkerboard. Light from upper left, short soft shadow lower right. No people, weapons racks, animals, banners, flags, text, pseudoletters, watermark, UI, plants or modern items. One static orientation.
